## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at L’Aquàrium de Barcelona, del Port Vell, Moll d'Espanya, s/n, Ciutat Vella, 08039 Barcelona, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Barcelona Aquarium. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The ticket to Barcelona Aquarium is included in this self-guided sightseeing audio walk, through Barcelona. Please note that an audio tour inside the Aquarium is not provided.
>
> Your route begins at L’Aquàrium de Barcelona in Port Vell, where yachts, quay walls, and the smell of salt set the scene for the city’s long bond with the Mediterranean. After you visit the Aquarium, unpause the tour and follow a route through Barcelona. You will walk into the Born to Santa Maria del Mar, continue through Ciutadella Park and the Arc de Triomf, then cross Plaça de Catalunya into the Gothic Quarter. Along the way, you stop at the mosaic mural The World Comes To Life With Each Kiss, the Cathedral of Barcelona, La Boqueria, and Palau Güell.
>
> The tour ends at the Christopher Columbus Monument by the waterfront, bringing you back to the sea where the story began. On the way, you will experience the contrast between bright harbor views and narrow medieval streets, see soaring Gothic stonework, colorful market stalls, elegant park avenues, and Gaudí’s dramatic architecture. Expect memorable moments such as standing before Santa Maria del Mar, watching the giant kiss image appear from hundreds of tiny photos, and arriving at the tall Columbus column above the port.
